title: AWS re:Invent 2018: Powering Next-Gen EC2 Instances: Deep Dive into the Nitro System (CMP303-R1)
summary: An AWS re:Invent 2018 session diving into the Nitro system, a set of hardware offload and security building blocks behind next-generation EC2 instances. It covers the design and architecture and how Nitro enables new instance types.
why: Cited as the primary source on how Nitro offloads I/O to dedicated hardware and keeps management tasks off guest CPUs.

quote.text: With the Nitro hypervisor, there are no management tasks that share CPUs with guest workloads.
